title: mvgkde
details: Multivariate Gaussian kernel density estimation in JAX, with full control of the kernel's covariance, including a bandwidth per dimension.

highlight.alt: The mvgkde logo: a kernel density estimate of points scattered along a slanted, handwritten M, drawn as filled contours from cream through gold and green to deep blue.
highlight.description: A multivariate Gaussian kernel density estimator in JAX, with full control of the bandwidth matrix: differentiable, vectorized, and per-dimension tunable.
